# An enum value held in a variable, run on four backends.
#
# Three defects, each visible only by running the program. Go and JavaScript
# spelled a parameter or local of enum type that the expression context could
# not resolve as the member of that name, so `func pick(r Mood) Mood { return r }`
# returned the string "r". Kotlin declared no class for a library enum a
# program stored, so `var w = ui.FontWeight.bold` named Compose's own
# FontWeight, which has no BOLD. And Kotlin printed a member by its entry name,
# `HAPPY`, where every other target prints the name as declared.
#
# The values are copied into state by a mount effect because a test agent reads
# a component's own state rather than an expression over it.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
    go {
        bubbletea
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
}

enum Mood { happy, sad }

struct Look {
    weight ui.FontWeight
}

func pick(r Mood) Mood {
    return r
}

func flip(r Mood) Mood {
    var held = r
    var other Mood = sad
    if held == other {
        return happy
    }
    return other
}

component main ui.node {
    var mood = Mood.happy
    var w = ui.FontWeight.bold
    var look = Look{weight = ui.FontWeight.lighter}

    var picked = ""
    var flipped = ""
    var shown = ""
    var converted = ""
    var weight = ""
    var field = ""

    effect(@mount {
        picked = string(pick(mood))
        flipped = string(flip(mood))
        shown = "{mood}"
        converted = string(mood)
        weight = "{w}"
        field = string(look.weight)
    })

    ui.text(value=shown)
}

func testParamIsItsValue(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.picked == "happy")
}

func testLocalsAreTheirValues(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.flipped == "sad")
}

func testInterpolationPrintsTheDeclaredName(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.shown == "happy")
}

func testConversionPrintsTheDeclaredName(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.converted == "happy")
}

func testLibraryEnumInAVar(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.weight == "bold")
}

func testLibraryEnumInAField(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.field == "lighter")
}

ui.window {
    main()
}
